newsitem.title: USA: Perot Systems acquires technology consulting firm.
newsitem.headline: Perot Systems acquires technology consulting firm.

text.p: Perot Systems Corp on Monday said it has acquired The Technical Resource Connection Inc, a provider of distributed object-oriented consulting services and solutions based in Tampa, Florida.
Terms of the transaction were not released.
The Technical Resource Connection will retain its name and become a wholly owned subsidiary of Perot Systems.
Perot said the merger is the latest in a series of investments Perot Systems has made to bolster its object-oriented and Internet skills.

In a statement, James A. Cannavino, Perot's president and chief executive said, "Our clients expect their new information systems to yield results much faster than ever before and investing in object technology is critical to our ability to meet their needs."
